desc.en: The National Museum of Montenegro is the largest museum in Montenegro.
desc.es: Museo Nacional de Montenegro se encuentra en Cetiña, capital histórica del país europeo de Montenegro.

desc.en: The Church-Mosque of Ulcinj, also called Imperial Mosque, Halil Skura Mosque, Kalaja Mosque or Church of St. Maria is a former church and mosque located in Ulcinj, Montenegro.
desc.es: Edificio histórico de Ulcinj que ha funcionado como iglesia y como mezquita.

desc.en: Lipa Cave is a karst cave situated close to Cetinje, Montenegro.

desc.en: The Bay of Kotor, also known as the Gulf of Kotor or just as the Boka, is a winding bay of the Adriatic Sea in southwestern Montenegro and the region of Montenegro concentrated around the bay.
desc.es: Las bocas de Kotor o también bahía de Kotor es una bahía sumamente accidentada de la zona suroccidental de Montenegro y suroriental de Croacia, en el área limítrofe entre ambos países, en la costa del mar Adriático.

desc.en: Lake Skadar or Lake Scutari – also called Lake Shkodra and Lake Shkodër – lies on the border of Albania and Montenegro, and is the largest lake in Southern Europe.
